stage1.impression: A clean, legible three-quarter hero of a milk-carton speaker on a grey sweep with wide copy space on the left, but the light is flat: the mid-grey set drains the whites, the left side face reads as a near-uniform bright slab beside a dull grey front, and only the gable's red really sings. The base sits in a soft smudge rather than a crisp contact and the surfaces read as clean CG, so it is a competent draft, not yet a homepage image.

blocking_9: Presence: the backdrop beside the side face sits at least 35 levels below the side face (now 164.4 vs 189.9, 26 levels), so the white body reads white rather than light grey on grey.
Depth: the copy space falls off at least 12 levels toward the frame's left edge while staying even enough for type (now 159 to 166 across 735 px, falloff -7: one flat value).
Grounding: the floor 2 to 11 px under the plinth's edge is at most 0.6 of the open floor 40 px further out (now 125.7 vs 164.8 = 0.76 under the back face, 143.1 vs 171.8 = 0.83 at the front corner).

One red: the plinth's lit back face within dE2000 5 of #C62828 (now 7.3 left of SHAKE WELL, 8.7 right of it, 11.9 on the side) while the gable roof stays within 4 (now 3.5) and the fin within 3 (now 2.0).
No CG fringe: the 2 px line along the gable hip and the top of the body's left edge at or below 238 (now 246 to 255, clipped).
Neutral whites: dE2000 at most 1 to a neutral grey of the same lightness on the back and side faces (now 1.3 to 2.5, lilac: a* +0.7 to +1.6, b* -0.9 to -1.3).

The lacquer reads as lacquer, not paint: a soft graduated reflection on the back face's upper third at least 10 levels over its diffuse base without veiling the label, and a sheen gradient on the red roof (its vertical profile is flat now, 85.7 to 86.0).
White print holds tone: OPEN OTHER SIDE at or below 248 (now 254 on 6.8 percent of the lettering box [828,96,960,114], flat white with no shading; the fin sits nearest the key).

changes.problem: The mid-grey paper sits too close to the white lacquer, so the body reads light grey on grey and the product has no presence.

out_of_scope.request: Render the spread version at 4000 px wide or more.
out_of_scope.why: At 1350 x 900 the Nutrition Facts rows are about 6 px tall and the amplifier's connections span 68 x 25 px: enough for a homepage, too small to hold across a magazine spread; the frame size and sampling are fixed by the card.

out_of_scope.request: A higher-gloss clear coat on the white lacquer and the red roof.
out_of_scope.why: The faces read as satin paint (the roof's vertical profile is flat, 85.7 to 86.0; the back face shows only diffuse falloff, 230 to 209); the product's materials are fixed, so the lacquer can only read through what it reflects, which is listed under blocking_9.
